title: AgentFaultBench: State-Verified Evaluation of Tool-Fault Recovery
abstract: arXiv:2611.20711v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Does recovery advice help an agent finish a task after a tool fails? AgentFaultBench evaluates LangGraph and CrewAI agents performing specified tasks in an isolated GitLab installation. We inject tool errors and check both the resulting files and issues and the required reads, verification and final response. The prompt supplies the expected issue and report text, so the task tests execution rather than content generation. In the primary comparison of 1,944 planned runs, advice changes success by -8.33, 0.00 and +1.06 percentage points relative to a neutral reminder; missing outcomes leave the latter two comparisons inconclusive. Later experiments test a revised recovery policy. GPT-4o mini improves, while Sol and Claude already complete the recoverable cases. In a separate 624-run study on six related tasks not previously used by that policy, the guided condition records 161 correct final states and one unknown outcome in 192 planned ru

translated_title: AgentFaultBench：基于状态验证的工具故障恢复评估
translated_abstract: 恢复建议是否有助于智能体在工具故障后完成任务？AgentFaultBench 评估了 LangGraph 和 CrewAI 智能体在一个隔离的 GitLab 安装环境中执行指定任务的表现。我们注入工具错误，并同时检查生成的文件与议题以及所需的读取、验证和最终响应。提示词中提供了预期的议题和报告文本，因此该任务测试的是执行能力而非内容生成能力。在包含 1,944 次计划运行的主要对比中，相对于中性提醒，恢复建议使成功率分别变化了 -8.33、0.00 和 +1.06 个百分点；由于部分结果缺失，后两项对比尚无定论。后续实验测试了一种修订后的恢复策略：GPT-4o mini 有所改进，而 Sol 和 Claude 已能完成可恢复的案例。在一项针对六种相关任务、共 624 次运行的独立研究中（这些任务此前未被该策略使用过），引导条件在 192 次计划运行中记录了 161 个正确的最终状态和 1 个未知结果。
tldr: 该论文提出 AgentFaultBench，一个在隔离 GitLab 环境中通过注入工具故障并验证最终状态来评估 LangGraph 和 CrewAI 智能体工具故障恢复能力的基准，发现恢复建议对成功率的影响很小或不确定，而修订后的恢复策略能提升 GPT-4o mini 等模型的表现。
en_tdlr: AgentFaultBench is a state-verified benchmark that evaluates tool-fault recovery of LangGraph and CrewAI agents by injecting tool errors in an isolated GitLab environment, finding that recovery advice has minimal or inconclusive effects on success rates, while a revised recovery policy improves models such as GPT-4o mini.
